name: Robotic Automatic Backplate Feeder
summary: Automated equipment for automatically placing backplanes into product assembly stations, working in coordination with robots to complete precision assembly.
contentHtml:
The robotic automatic backplane placement machine is an automated device developed by TXAM for the backplane placement process.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a robot combined with a precision positioning system to automatically pick up and place backplanes onto the product assembly station. It works in coordination with assembly robots to achieve fully automated backplane installation.

Technical Advantages

  • Robotic automated placement for high efficiency
  • Precise positioning ensures assembly accuracy
  • High level of automation reduces manual intervention
  • Stable quality control for consistent product output
